quote: Am I my brother's keeper?
note: Cain's reply when God asked where Abel was.

quote: Ye shall not surely die.
note: The serpent's words to the woman about the forbidden fruit.

quote: The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
note: Eve answers God in the garden.

quote: Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go?
note: Pharaoh's answer to Moses and Aaron.

quote: Choose you this day whom ye will serve; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
note: Joshua's challenge to Israel at Shechem.

quote: Whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge.
note: Ruth's vow to stay with Naomi.

quote: If I perish, I perish.
note: Esther's resolve before approaching the king uninvited.

quote: The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.
note: Job's response after losing his children and possessions.

quote: Here am I; send me.
note: Isaiah's answer in the temple vision.

quote: Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
note: Solomon's test to expose the real mother.

quote: Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word.
note: Mary's response to the angel Gabriel.

quote: Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
note: Said when he saw Jesus coming toward him.

quote: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
note: Peter's confession at Caesarea Philippi.

quote: What is truth?
note: Pilate to Jesus during the trial.

quote: My Lord and my God.
note: Thomas after seeing the risen Jesus.

quote: He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
note: Jesus to those who brought a woman accused of adultery.

quote: Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
note: The voice Saul heard on the Damascus road.

quote: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.
note: Paul in his final letter to Timothy.

quote: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD.
note: Moses' charge to Israel, known as the Shema.

quote: I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
note: Jacob to the man who wrestled with him at the Jabbok.

quote: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.
note: Joseph to his brothers after Jacob's death.

quote: The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
note: Isaac, blind and suspicious, about the son in front of him.

quote: Thou art the man.
note: Nathan confronting David about Bathsheba and Uriah.

quote: Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts.
note: David to Goliath.

quote: Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
note: Samuel rebuking King Saul.

quote: How long halt ye between two opinions?
note: Elijah to the people on Mount Carmel.

quote: Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
note: Mordecai urging Esther to act.

quote: What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
note: The LORD opened the donkey's mouth to speak.

quote: Doth Job fear God for nought?
note: Satan's challenge to God about Job's loyalty.

quote: Thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church.
note: Jesus to Simon after his confession.

quote: Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee.
note: Peter to the lame man at the temple gate.

quote: Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth?
note: Nathanael's reaction when Philip described Jesus.

quote: How can a man be born when he is old?
note: Nicodemus puzzled by being born again.

quote: Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
note: A blind beggar near Jericho.

quote: What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you?
note: Judas to the chief priests.

quote: He must increase, but I must decrease.
note: John speaking about Jesus' growing ministry.

quote: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day.
note: Caleb, at eighty-five, asks for Hebron's hill country.

quote: Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness.
note: His riddle at the wedding feast.

quote: Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
note: Naomi returning to Bethlehem.

quote: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him.
note: Hannah presenting young Samuel at Shiloh.

quote: Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
note: Saul after David spared his life in the wilderness.

quote: How are the mighty fallen!
note: David's lament for Saul and Jonathan.

quote: Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
note: To his frightened servant surrounded by an army at Dothan.

quote: I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down.
note: Replying to those who wanted him to leave the wall.

quote: Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
note: Said on his palace roof, just before he lost his reason.

quote: Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace.
note: Their answer to the king before the furnace.

quote: I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.
note: Jonah answering the sailors who asked who he was.

quote: Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
note: Jeremiah's response when called as a prophet.

quote: Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
note: The angel to Mary in Nazareth.

quote: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word.
note: Simeon holding the infant Jesus in the temple.

quote: Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
note: Peter after many disciples turned away.

quote: Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.
note: Festus interrupting Paul's defense.

quote: Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
note: Stephen's vision before the council.

quote: Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
note: After an earthquake opened the prison doors in Philippi.

quote: I will go.
note: Asked whether she would leave with Abraham's servant.

quote: I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
note: Esau declining Jacob's gift at their reunion.

quote: Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
note: Pharaoh to his servants about Joseph.

quote: Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
note: The people at the foot of Sinai after the thunder.

quote: Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day.
note: Joshua to Achan after the defeat at Ai.

quote: There is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.
note: Jonathan proposing a raid on a Philistine outpost.

quote: Whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken?
note: Samuel's farewell speech to Israel.

quote: Thou hast asked a hard thing.
note: Elijah's reply when Elisha asked for a double portion of his spirit.

quote: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel?
note: Naaman's angry reaction to the prophet's instruction.

quote: Hast thou found me, O mine enemy?
note: Ahab to Elijah after the seizure of Naboth's vineyard.

quote: I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman.
note: Amos to the priest Amaziah at Bethel.

quote: His name is John.
note: Written on a tablet while he could not speak.

quote: We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
note: Philip telling Nathanael about Jesus.

quote: Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
note: Said of Nathanael as he approached.

quote: Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
note: Felix after Paul spoke of righteousness and judgment to come.

quote: Refrain from these men, and let them alone.
note: Advising the council about the apostles.

quote: Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
note: Paul reminding the sailors of his earlier warning.

quote: Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
note: Agrippa's reply to Paul's defense.
